hero.headline:
Homes beside SRM,
let the honest way.
hero.sub: Every 2.75 and 3 BHK flat for rent across every block, with rent, deposit and maintenance listed up front. Visits arranged around your timetable.

why.title: Walk, cycle or scooter to SRM
why.body: The main gate is 1.5 km away. Most students never need a cab, and Potheri station is closer still.

why.title: Bigger than a hostel, saner than a PG
why.body: 1,200 to 1,600 sq ft, with cross-ventilation, balconies and a study. Split four ways, it often costs less than co-living.

why.title: Towers around a landscaped green, beside the lake
why.body: Families, faculty and young professionals. A pool, rooftop club pool, jogging track and gym, with security at the gate.

why.title: GST Road, MWC and the airport
why.body: GST Road is three minutes away. Mahindra World City is a 25-minute drive and the airport about 45.
